service:
You can use the Billing API to programatically list the billing views available to you for a given time period. A billing view represents a set of billing data.

The Billing API provides the following endpoint:

https://billing.us-east-1.api.aws

operations.AssociateContract: Private Pricing contracts let eligible payer accounts manage private pricing agreements with Amazon Web Services. This operation associates a private pricing contract with the caller's Amazon Web Services account. The caller must be a payer (management) account listed on the contract. This operation is idempotent, so retrying a request that already succeeded is safe.
operations.AssociateSourceViews: Associates one or more source billing views with an existing billing view. This allows creating aggregate billing views that combine data from multiple sources.
operations.CancelContractualInvestmentAttestation: Cancels a contractual investment attestation. This operation is idempotent, so retrying is safe. You can cancel an attestation only while it is still pending (its isCancellable value is true).
operations.CreateBillingView: Creates a billing view with the specified billing view attributes.
operations.CreateContractualInvestmentAttestation: Creates an attestation that claims an investment award for a completed milestone or outcome within a private pricing contract. Supply a clientToken to make the request idempotent so a safe retry does not create a duplicate attestation. This operation starts an asynchronous review and returns an attestationId while the attestation is pending.
operations.DisassociateContract: Removes the association between a private pricing contract and your Amazon Web Services account. The account must have been associated with the contract previously. This operation is idempotent, so retrying is safe.
operations.DisassociateSourceViews: Removes the association between one or more source billing views and an existing billing view. This allows modifying the composition of aggregate billing views.
operations.GetBillingPreferences: Retrieves billing preferences for the specified feature. Each feature controls a distinct billing capability: which accounts can share Reserved Instances or credits, whether billing alerts are enabled, the historical record of sharing changes, and per-credit options.
operations.GetBillingView: Returns the metadata associated to the specified billing view ARN.
operations.GetContractInformation: Returns information about a specific private pricing contract, including its term (duration), eligible payer accounts, investment accounts, and legal entities. This operation is read-only.
operations.GetCreditAllocationHistory: Returns the per-billing-month allocation history for credits applied to an Amazon Web Services account's bills. Traverses the consolidated billing family to capture cross-account credit applications. Supports pagination and optional filtering to a single credit.
operations.GetCredits:
Returns the list of Amazon Web Services account credits for the specified account. Each credit includes its identifier, type, monetary amounts, applicable products, expiration, sharing configuration, and current enabled status.

When the caller is the management account of a consolidated billing family and payerAccountFlag is true, the response aggregates credits across the entire family. Otherwise, the response includes only credits owned by the account specified in accountId.
operations.GetEnterpriseSupportChargeSummary: Returns a summary of Enterprise Support data aggregated across all accounts in the Enterprise Support profile.
operations.GetResourcePolicy: Returns the resource-based policy document attached to the resource in JSON format.
operations.ListBillingViewSegments:
Lists the segments of a billing view over a given time period. Each segment identifies the billing domain (PRO_FORMA or BILLABLE) and the account relationships that apply during its time range.

If you don't provide an arn, the response includes segments for the caller's PRIMARY billing view.

If a mid-period change occurs, the response includes multiple segments, each with its own time range. The response omits hidden segments, so the segments it returns might not cover the entire requested time period.
operations.ListBillingViews:
Lists the billing views available for a given time period.

Every Amazon Web Services account has a unique PRIMARY billing view that represents the billing data available by default. Accounts that use Billing Conductor also have BILLING_GROUP billing views representing pro forma costs associated with each created billing group.
operations.ListBusinessSupportAccountCharges: Returns Business Support charges broken down at the linked account level for a given billing month.
operations.ListBusinessSupportSubscriptionHistory: Returns the history of Business Support subscription contracts across accounts.
operations.ListContracts: Lists the private pricing contracts that your Amazon Web Services account is an eligible payer account of. This operation is read-only and paginated.
operations.ListContractualInvestmentAttestations: Lists the investment attestations submitted under a specific private pricing contract. Use this operation to track attestation status, including the terminal statuses DISBURSED, REJECTED, and CANCELLED. This operation is read-only and paginated.
operations.ListContractualInvestmentSummaries: Lists the investment summaries within a specific private pricing contract. This operation is read-only and paginated.
operations.ListContractualInvestments: Lists the investments within a specific investment summary. This operation is read-only and paginated.
operations.ListEnterpriseSupportLinkedAccountCharge: Returns Support-eligible spend broken down at linked account level.
operations.ListSourceViewsForBillingView: Lists the source views (managed Amazon Web Services billing views) associated with the billing view.
operations.ListTagsForResource: Lists tags associated with the billing view resource.
operations.RedeemCredits: Redeems an Amazon Web Services promotional credit code on behalf of the calling account. On success, a new credit is added to the account's credit ledger with the amount, validity period, and applicable products defined by the promotion. The credit is then automatically applied to subsequent bills according to the standard credit application order.
operations.TagResource: An API operation for adding one or more tags (key-value pairs) to a resource.
operations.UntagResource: Removes one or more tags from a resource. Specify only tag keys in your request. Don't specify the value.
operations.UpdateBillingPreferences:
Updates billing preferences for the specified feature. Each feature targets a distinct billing capability and has its own set of supported keys. The action sets the value for each provided key; keys not present in the request are unchanged.

Sharing keys (RI_SHARING, CREDIT_SHARING, CREDIT_LEVEL_SHARING, and sharing keys under CREDIT_PREFERENCE_OPTIONS) may only be set by the management account of a consolidated billing family. The credit/{creditId}/status key may be set by member accounts for credits they own, or by the management account for any credit in the family.
operations.UpdateBillingView: An API to update the attributes of the billing view.

AccessDeniedException.base: You don't have sufficient access to perform this action.

refs.BillingPreferenceSummary$accountId: The associated Amazon Web Services account ID. Populated for account-list keys; null otherwise.
refs.BillingViewElement$ownerAccountId: The account owner of the billing view.
refs.BillingViewElement$sourceAccountId: The Amazon Web Services account ID that owns the source billing view, if this is a derived billing view.
refs.BillingViewListElement$ownerAccountId: The list of owners of the Billing view.
refs.BillingViewListElement$sourceAccountId: The Amazon Web Services account ID that owns the source billing view, if this is a derived billing view.
refs.BillingViewSegmentsListElement$billingTr: The billing transfer account ID. The response includes this field only when the caller is a billing transfer source account. The response omits this field for billing group billing views.
refs.BillingViewSegmentsListElement$managemen: The management account ID of the organization. The response includes this field for organization member accounts.
refs.BillingViewSegmentsListElement$billingGr: The billing group primary account ID. The response includes this field for billing group members. Compare this value to your own account ID to determine whether you are the primary account.
refs.BusinessSupportSubscriptionContract$acco: The account ID associated with this subscription contract.
refs.CreditAllocationHistoryEntry$accountId: The Amazon Web Services account the credit was applied to.
refs.CreditData$accountId: The Amazon Web Services account ID that owns the credit.
refs.GetCreditAllocationHistoryRequest$accoun: The Amazon Web Services account ID whose allocation history to retrieve. Must be a 12-digit numeric string.
refs.GetEnterpriseSupportChargeSummaryRespons: The payer account ID that is authorized to view Enterprise Support data for all accounts in its Support profile.
refs.InvestmentDistribution$accountId: The recipient Amazon Web Services account ID that receives this portion of the investment. This must be one of the eligible investment accounts on the contract.
refs.LinkedAccountCharge$payerAccountId: The payer account ID that is authorized to view Enterprise Support data for all accounts in its Support profile.
refs.ListBillingViewsRequest$ownerAccountId: The list of owners of the billing view.
refs.ListBillingViewsRequest$sourceAccountId: Filters the results to include only billing views that use the specified account as a source.
refs.ListBusinessSupportAccountChargesRequest: The linked account ID to filter results to a specific account. If you don't specify a value, the response includes charges for all linked accounts.
refs.ListBusinessSupportSubscriptionHistoryRe: The account ID to filter results to a specific account. If you don't specify a value, the response includes subscription history for all accounts.
refs.ListEnterpriseSupportLinkedAccountCharge: The linked account ID to filter results to a specific account. If you don't specify a value, the response includes charges for all linked accounts.

AccountList.base: A list of 12-digit Amazon Web Services account IDs. The list contains at most 100 account IDs.

refs.PrivatePricingAddendum$eligiblePayerAcco: The payer accounts that are eligible under the private pricing addendum. The list contains at most 100 account IDs.
refs.PrivatePricingAddendum$investmentAccount: The accounts that are eligible to receive investments under the private pricing addendum. An InvestmentDistribution must target one of these accounts. The list contains at most 100 account IDs.

refs.BillingPreferenceSummary$accountName: The display name of the account. Populated together with accountId; null otherwise.

ActiveTimeRange.base: A time range with a start and end time.

refs.ListBillingViewsRequest$activeTimeRange: The time range for the billing views listed. PRIMARY billing view is always listed. BILLING_GROUP billing views are listed for time ranges when the associated billing group resource in Billing Conductor is active. The time range must be within one calendar month.

AdditionalCharge.base: An additional charge applied to an Enterprise Support contract.

refs.GetEnterpriseSupportContractDetailsRespo: Any Additional support charges applied to the contract.

AdditionalRecipient.base: A recipient copied as a viewer on the executive approval request, in addition to the approver.

AdditionalRecipients.base: A list of recipients copied as viewers on the executive approval request. The list contains at most 10 recipients.

refs.CreateContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: The email addresses to copy as viewers on the executive approval request.

Amount.base: A monetary amount with a currency code. Used throughout the Billing API to represent credit balances, allocations, and adjustments.

refs.AttestationValue$attestationAmount: The value attested as a monetary amount. This form is valid only when the investment has no multiplier.
refs.CreditAllocationHistoryEntry$creditAmoun: The amount of credit applied. Negative values represent credits that reduced the bill.
refs.CreditData$initialAmount: The initial amount of the credit when it was issued.
refs.CreditData$estimatedAmount: The estimated remaining balance, including in-flight (open) bills that have not yet been finalized.
refs.InvestmentDistribution$investmentAmount: The monetary value allocated to the recipient account.
refs.InvestmentRestriction$amount: The maximum monetary amount allowed under the restriction.
refs.InvestmentSummary$maxAllowedInvestmentDi: The maximum monetary value that can be disbursed against the investment summary, inclusive of all outcomes combined under the summary.
refs.MilestoneBasedInvestment$investmentValue: The total value of the investment, including its currency and amount.
refs.OutcomeBasedInvestment$disbursedValue: The total value already disbursed against the investment. This value can be distributed among the investment accounts distribution.

refs.CreditData$applicationType: When the credit is applied during bill computation. Valid values: BEFORE_CROSS_SERVICE_DISCOUNTS, AFTER_DISCOUNTS.

ApproverDetails.base: Information about the executive approver who signs off on an investment attestation.

refs.CreateContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: The details of the executive who authorized the attestation, under the terms of the private pricing contract. The executive receives a click-to-accept email to confirm the attestation.

refs.AssociateContractRequest$contractArn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract to associate with your account.
refs.CancelContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract that contains the attested investment.
refs.ContractSummary$contractArn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract. Pass this value to operations such as GetContractInformation, ListContractualInvestmentSummaries, and AssociateContract.
refs.CreateContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract that contains the investment being attested.
refs.DisassociateContractRequest$contractArn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract to disassociate from your account.
refs.GetContractInformationRequest$contractAr: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract to retrieve information about.
refs.ListContractualInvestmentAttestationsReq: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract whose attestations you want to list.
refs.ListContractualInvestmentSummariesReques: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract whose investment summaries you want to list.
refs.ListContractualInvestmentsRequest$contra: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract that contains the investment summary.
refs.PrivatePricingAddendum$contractArn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the private pricing addendum.

AssociationStatus.base: Indicates whether a contract is associated with your account. A value of ASSOCIATED indicates that the contract is associated with your account. A value of NOT_ASSOCIATED indicates that the contract is not associated with your account.

refs.ContractSummary$associationStatus: Indicates whether the contract is currently associated with your account. Valid values are ASSOCIATED and NOT_ASSOCIATED. ASSOCIATED means the contract is associated with your account. NOT_ASSOCIATED means the contract is not associated with your account.

refs.CreateContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: A unique, case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request. If you retry a request that completed successfully using the same client token and parameters, the retry completes without performing any further actions.

AttestationDetails.base: The details of an investment attestation submission, including the value being attested and how the resulting investment is distributed.

refs.CreateContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: The details of the attestation, including the value being claimed and how the resulting investment is distributed across investment accounts.

AttestationQuantities.base: A list of quantity-based attestation values. The list contains at most 50 quantities.

refs.AttestationValue$attestationQuantities: The value attested as one or more quantities, each with its own unit. The list contains at most 50 quantities.

AttestationQuantity.base: A quantity-based attestation value, such as a count of workloads migrated.

refs.AttestationQuantity$attestationUnit: The unit of the attestation, such as workloads migrated. This value is 1–1000 characters.

refs.AttestationQuantity$attestationVolume: The number of units being attested, expressed as a decimal string to preserve precision. The value is digits with an optional decimal point and is 1–1000 characters.

AttestationValue.base: The value being attested. This is a union in which exactly one member is set. Set attestationAmount to attest a monetary amount directly, or set attestationQuantities to attest one or more quantities that are converted to a value using the investment's multipliers.

refs.AttestationDetails$attestationValue: The value being attested, expressed as either a monetary amount or one or more quantities. Exactly one form is set.

BillingDomain.base:
The billing domain for a billing view segment. The following values are valid:

  • PRO_FORMA - Data shaped by Billing Conductor that doesn't reflect the final charges owed to Amazon Web Services.

  • BILLABLE - Data that represents the final charges owed to Amazon Web Services.

refs.BillingViewSegmentsListElement$domain:
The billing domain for this segment. The following values are valid:

  • PRO_FORMA - Data shaped by Billing Conductor that doesn't reflect the final charges owed to Amazon Web Services.

  • BILLABLE - Data that represents the final charges owed to Amazon Web Services.

refs.UpdateBillingPreferencesRequest$feature: The feature to update. Valid values: BILLING_ALERTS, RI_SHARING, CREDIT_SHARING, CREDIT_LEVEL_SHARING, CREDIT_PREFERENCE_OPTIONS. The history features (RI_SHARING_HISTORY and CREDIT_SHARING_HISTORY) are read-only and cannot be updated.

BillingFeatureFilter.base: A filter that narrows the set of preferences returned by GetBillingPreferences.

refs.BillingFeatureFilter$name: The filter name. Currently the only supported value is PREFERENCE_KEY.

refs.BillingFeatureFilter$value: The filter values to match. For PREFERENCE_KEY, supply 1 to 10 preference key values to match.

refs.CreditAllocationHistoryEntry$billingMont: The billing month of the application in YYYY-MM format.

BillingPeriod.base: A specific billing period identified by year and month.

refs.BillingPreferenceSummary$billingPeriod: The billing period associated with the preference change. Populated only for the history features RI_SHARING_HISTORY and CREDIT_SHARING_HISTORY.

BillingPreferenceForKey.base: A single key/value entry used to update a billing preference.

BillingPreferenceSummary.base: A single billing preference entry returned by GetBillingPreferences.

refs.GetBillingPreferencesResponse$billingPre: The list of preference entries matching the request.

refs.UpdateBillingPreferencesRequest$billingP: Key/value pairs to apply. All keys in a single request must be valid for the specified feature and must not be duplicated. For CREDIT_PREFERENCE_OPTIONS, all keys must reference the same creditId.

refs.AssociateSourceViewsRequest$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the billing view to associate source views with.
refs.AssociateSourceViewsResponse$arn: The ARN of the billing view that the source views were associated with.
refs.BillingViewElement$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.BillingViewListElement$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.CreateBillingViewResponse$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.DeleteBillingViewRequest$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.DeleteBillingViewResponse$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.DisassociateSourceViewsRequest$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the billing view to disassociate source views from.
refs.DisassociateSourceViewsResponse$arn: The ARN of the billing view that the source views were disassociated from.
refs.GetBillingViewRequest$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.ListBillingViewSegmentsRequest$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the billing view to query. If you don't provide an ARN, the caller's PRIMARY billing view is used. The ARN must reference a primary billing view. Custom billing views aren't supported.
refs.ListSourceViewsForBillingViewRequest$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.UpdateBillingViewRequest$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.
refs.UpdateBillingViewResponse$arn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.

refs.ListBillingViewsRequest$arns: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that can be used to uniquely identify the billing view.

refs.BillingViewElement$description: The description of the billing view.
refs.BillingViewListElement$description: The description of the billing view.
refs.CreateBillingViewRequest$description: The description of the billing view.
refs.UpdateBillingViewRequest$description: The description of the billing view.

BillingViewElement.base: The metadata associated to the billing view.

refs.GetBillingViewResponse$billingView: The billing view element associated with the specified ARN.

BillingViewHealthStatus.base: Represents the health status of a billing view, including a status code and optional reasons for the status.

refs.BillingViewElement$healthStatus: The current health status of the billing view.
refs.BillingViewListElement$healthStatus: The current health status of the billing view.

BillingViewHealthStatusException.base: Exception thrown when a billing view's health status prevents an operation from being performed. This may occur if the billing view is in a state other than HEALTHY.

refs.BillingViewElement$name: The account name of the billing view.
refs.BillingViewListElement$name: A list of names of the Billing view.
refs.CreateBillingViewRequest$name: The name of the billing view.
refs.UpdateBillingViewRequest$name: The name of the billing view.

BillingViewSegmentTimeRange.base: Specifies a time range with an inclusive begin date and an exclusive end date.

refs.BillingViewSegmentsListElement$timeRange: The time range during which this segment is effective.
refs.ListBillingViewSegmentsRequest$timeRange: The billing period to query. If you don't provide a time range, the current billing period, which is the calendar month in UTC, is used.

BillingViewSegmentsList.base: A list of billing view segments.

refs.ListBillingViewSegmentsResponse$items: A list of billing view segments. Each segment covers a portion of the requested time period. The response omits hidden segments, so the segments it returns might not cover the entire requested time period.

BillingViewSegmentsListElement.base: A billing view segment. A segment represents a time range during which the billing domain and account relationships for a billing view remained unchanged.

refs.AssociateSourceViewsRequest$sourceViews: A list of ARNs of the source billing views to associate.
refs.CreateBillingViewRequest$sourceViews: A list of billing views used as the data source for the custom billing view.
refs.DisassociateSourceViewsRequest$sourceVie: A list of ARNs of the source billing views to disassociate.
refs.ListSourceViewsForBillingViewResponse$so: A list of billing views used as the data source for the custom billing view.

refs.BillingViewHealthStatus$statusCode: The current health status code of the billing view.

refs.BillingViewHealthStatus$statusReasons: A list of reasons explaining the current health status, if applicable.

refs.ListBillingViewSegmentsRequest$maxResult: The number of entries a paginated response contains. Valid values range from 1 to 100. The default is 100.
refs.ListBillingViewsRequest$maxResults: The maximum number of billing views to retrieve. Default is 100.
refs.ListSourceViewsForBillingViewRequest$max: The number of entries a paginated response contains.

refs.BillingPeriod$year: The four-digit year of the billing period.

refs.ContractAccount$isGdn: When true, Support charges are calculated on charges before private discounts. When false, they are calculated after private discounts.
refs.CreditAllocationHistoryEntry$isEstimated: true when the entry was applied to an in-flight bill that has not yet been finalized.
refs.CreditData$accountHasCreditSharingEnable: Whether the owning account has account-level credit sharing turned on.
refs.DeleteBillingViewRequest$force: If set to true, forces deletion of the billing view even if it has derived resources (e.g. other billing views or budgets). Use with caution as this may break dependent resources.
refs.GetCreditAllocationHistoryResponse$parti: true when data could not be retrieved for one or more billing months. The failedMonths field lists which months are missing.
refs.GetCreditsRequest$payerAccountFlag: When true and the caller is the management account, the response aggregates credits across the entire consolidated billing family. When false or omitted, returns only credits for the specified accountId.
refs.GetEnterpriseSupportChargeSummaryRespons: Specifies whether the Support charge amount is estimated. When false, the charge amount is finalized.
refs.GetEnterpriseSupportContractDetailsRespo: When true, the Enterprise Support contract is active. When false, the Enterprise Support Contract is inactive.
refs.InvestmentAttestation$isCancellable: Indicates whether the attestation can be canceled with CancelContractualInvestmentAttestation.
refs.ListBusinessSupportAccountChargesRespons: Specifies whether the Support charge amount is estimated. When false, the charge amount is finalized.
refs.PricingPlan$discountAppliesToMinimumChar: Whether the discount applies to the minimum Support charge.
refs.PricingPlanTier$incremental: Whether the tier charges are calculated incrementally.

BusinessSupportAccountCharge.base: Business Support charges for a linked account.

BusinessSupportAccountChargeList.base: A list of Business Support account charges.

refs.ListBusinessSupportAccountChargesRespons: The list of Business Support charges per linked account.

BusinessSupportBillingMonth.base: A billing month in YYYY-MM format. Supports the current month (estimated charges) and past months (finalized charges).

refs.ListBusinessSupportAccountChargesRequest: The billing month to retrieve Business Support charges for, in YYYY-MM format. You can request the current month (charges will be estimated) or a past month (charges will be finalized).
refs.ListBusinessSupportAccountChargesRespons: The billing month for the returned charges, in YYYY-MM format.
refs.ListBusinessSupportSubscriptionHistoryRe: The billing month to retrieve subscription contracts for, in YYYY-MM format. If you don't specify a value, defaults to the current month.

BusinessSupportDiscount.base: A discount applied to a Business Support account charge, including the discount amount, percentage, type, and source.

refs.BusinessSupportAccountCharge$supportDisc: The discount applied to the Business Support charge for this account, if any. This field is absent when no discount applies.

BusinessSupportServiceSpend.base: A service-level spend entry contributing to Business Support eligible spend.

BusinessSupportServiceSpendList.base: A list of Business Support service spend entries.

refs.BusinessSupportAccountCharge$supportElig: The Support-eligible spend broken down by contributing service for this account.

BusinessSupportSubscriptionContract.base: A Business Support subscription contract for an account.

BusinessSupportSubscriptionContractList.base: A list of Business Support subscription contracts.

refs.ListBusinessSupportSubscriptionHistoryRe: The list of Business Support subscription contracts.

BusinessSupportTierCharge.base: A tier-level charge within a Business Support pricing plan. Business Support uses tiered pricing where different percentage rates apply to different ranges of Support-eligible spend.

BusinessSupportTierChargeList.base: A list of Business Support tier charges.

refs.BusinessSupportAccountCharge$tierCharges: The tier-level charges that make up the total Business Support charge for this account. Each tier represents a spend range with its own rate.

refs.CancelContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: The reason for the cancellation. This value can be 1 to 80 characters.

ChargeAccount.base: An account that is charged all or a portion of the total Support charge and the percentage of the charge allocated to it.

refs.GetEnterpriseSupportContractDetailsRespo: The list of payer accounts and their charge allocation percentages.

refs.CreateBillingViewRequest$clientToken: A unique, case-sensitive identifier you specify to ensure idempotency of the request. Idempotency ensures that an API request completes no more than one time. If the original request completes successfully, any subsequent retries complete successfully without performing any further actions with an idempotent request.

ConflictException.base: The requested operation would cause a conflict with the current state of a service resource associated with the request. Resolve the conflict before retrying this request.

ContractAccount.base: An account that is covered by the Enterprise Support contract.

ContractAccountList.base: A list of accounts that appear in the Enterprise Support Contract.

refs.GetEnterpriseSupportContractDetailsRespo: The list of accounts covered by the Enterprise Support contract.

ContractDetails.base: The details of a contract returned by GetContractInformation. This is a union in which exactly one member is set, corresponding to the contract type. For a private pricing addendum, the privatePricingAddendum member is set. Check which member is present to determine the contract type.

refs.GetContractInformationResponse$contract: The contract details such as term (duration), eligible payer accounts, investment accounts, and legal entities.

refs.AssociateContractRequest$contractDocumen: The contract ID from the contract document. It can be found in the top right corner of your contract's pages. This value confirms that you have access to the contract you are associating.
refs.CreateContractualInvestmentAttestationRe: The contract ID from the contract document, located in the top-right corner of the private pricing contract pages. This value confirms that you have access to the contract.

ContractRestriction.base: A restriction that limits the self-service actions you can take on a contract. A contract with no restrictions supports all self-service actions.

ContractRestrictions.base: A list of restrictions that apply to a contract. An empty or absent value indicates that no restrictions apply. The list contains at most 10 restrictions.

refs.PrivatePricingAddendum$contractRestricti: The restrictions that limit the self-service actions you can take on the private pricing addendum. An empty or absent value indicates that no restrictions apply. The list contains at most 10 restrictions.

ContractSummaries.base: A list of private pricing contract summaries, as returned by ListContracts.

refs.ListContractsResponse$items: The list of contracts that your Amazon Web Services account is an eligible payer account of.

ContractSummary.base: A summary of a private pricing contract visible to your account. ListContracts returns these summaries.

ContractType.base: The classification of a private pricing contract. A value of Cross-Service indicates that the contract terms apply across multiple Amazon Web Services services. A value of Service-Specific indicates that the contract terms apply to a specific Amazon Web Services service. A value of Other indicates that the contract terms apply to other arrangements.

refs.ContractSummary$contractType: The classification of the contract. Valid values are Cross-Service, Service-Specific, and Other. Cross-Service applies across multiple Amazon Web Services services. Service-Specific applies to a specific Amazon Web Services service. Other applies to other arrangements.

refs.CostCategoryValues$key: The unique name of the Cost Category.

CostCategoryValues.base: The Cost Categories values used for filtering the costs.

refs.Expression$costCategories: The filter that's based on CostCategory values.

CreditAllocationHistoryEntry.base: A single entry in the credit allocation history, representing how a credit was applied to a specific service during a billing month.

refs.GetCreditAllocationHistoryResponse$credi: Allocation entries sorted by billingMonth in descending order.

CreditData.base: Detailed information about an Amazon Web Services credit, including its identifier, type, monetary amounts, applicable products, sharing configuration, and current enabled status.

refs.GetCreditsResponse$credits: The list of credits matching the request. Returns an empty list when no credits exist.

refs.CreditAllocationHistoryEntry$creditId: The identifier of the credit that was applied.

refs.CreditData$creditSharingType: The sharing configuration for the credit. Valid values: DEFAULT, DISABLED, CUSTOM, COST_CATEGORY_RULE.

refs.CreditData$creditStatus: Whether the credit participates in billing runs. Valid values: ENABLED, DISABLED.

refs.Amount$currencyAmount: The amount as a decimal string (for example, "743.21"). Negative values represent credits that reduce a bill.

refs.Amount$currencyCode: The ISO 4217 currency code for the amount (for example, USD).

refs.DimensionValues$key: The names of the metadata types that you can use to filter and group your results.

DimensionValues.base: The metadata that you can use to filter and group your results.

EnterpriseSupportBillingMonth.base: The billing month in YYYY-MM format. This must be a month in the past.

refs.GetEnterpriseSupportChargeSummaryRequest: The billing month in YYYY-MM format. This must be a month in the past.
refs.GetEnterpriseSupportChargeSummaryRespons: The billing month in YYYY-MM format. This must be a month in the past.
refs.GetEnterpriseSupportContractDetailsReque: The billing month in YYYY-MM format. This must be a month in the past.
refs.ListEnterpriseSupportLinkedAccountCharge: The billing month in YYYY-MM format. This must be a month in the past.

EnterpriseSupportTimePeriod.base: A time period for Enterprise Support billing.

refs.ValidationExceptionField$message: The message describing why the field failed validation.

Expression.base: See Expression. Billing view only supports LINKED_ACCOUNT, Tags, and CostCategories.

refs.BillingViewElement$dataFilterExpression: See Expression. Billing view only supports LINKED_ACCOUNT, Tags, and CostCategories.
